description: Tests for all new API endpoints: tags CRUD, smart folders CRUD, templates CRUD, command palette search, activity feed, kanban board, breadcrumbs, expiry prediction, onboarding status. Follow existing test patterns in tests/conftest.py.
steps: 1. Create tests/test_tags.py: Test create tag, list tags, delete tag, add tag to document, remove tag from document, list document tags. Use the client fixture and create test user/document in each test.
2. Create tests/test_smart_folders.py: Test create smart folder, list smart folders, get by id, update, delete, execute query (GET /api/smart-folders/{id}/documents).
3. Create tests/test_templates.py: Test create template, list templates, get by id, update, delete, create document from template.
4. Create tests/test_command_palette.py: Test search returns documents matching query, groups matching query, empty results for no match.
5. Create tests/test_activity.py: Test global feed returns audit entries, per-document feed filters correctly, pagination works.
6. Create tests/test_kanban.py: Test kanban endpoint returns board with columns, documents correctly grouped by lifecycle state.
7. Create tests/test_breadcrumbs.py: Test breadcrumbs for nested groups (3 levels deep), root group has single breadcrumb.
8. Create tests/test_expiry_prediction.py: Test prediction endpoint returns prediction data, handles document without lifecycle gracefully.
9. Create tests/test_onboarding.py: Test GET status returns completed=False initially, POST complete sets it to True, subsequent GET returns True.
acceptance_criteria: All new test files pass: uv run pytest tests/test_tags.py tests/test_smart_folders.py tests/test_templates.py tests/test_command_palette.py tests/test_activity.py tests/test_kanban.py tests/test_breadcrumbs.py tests/test_expiry_prediction.py tests/test_onboarding.py -v
Full test suite passes (620 + new tests)
Each test exercises real API endpoints with actual DB operations (not mocked)
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_tags.py tests/test_smart_folders.py tests/test_templates.py tests/test_command_palette.py tests/test_activity.py tests/test_kanban.py tests/test_breadcrumbs.py tests/test_expiry_prediction.py tests/test_onboarding.py -v
